title: Molecular Breast Imaging in Patients With a History of Bloody Nipple Discharge
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate molecular breast imaging in the workup of patients with a history of bloody nipple discharge, not reproducible in the office who have a negative clinical breast examination, and a negative diagnostic mammogram and breast ultrasound.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women age 25 - 75
* Women with a negative diagnostic mammogram and ultrasound
* Women with a history of bloody nipple discharge which can not be reproduced by the examining physician or the patient in the office

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or lactating
* Unable to understand or sign a consent form
* Physically unable to sit upright and still for 40 minutes
